Title: Results of the 2014 parisian league, part 1

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Lots of game were played during this first part of the parisian league. Romain held the first position for many weeks, even once exiled to England, but he lost it during the two last games of the period.

Detailled results are found here: www.veknfrance.com/forum/viewtopic.php?p=203685#203685

The rules are here: www.vekn.net/forum/9-event-reports-and-twd/42227-parisian-league-2012-qligue-de-parisq#42227

Surprinsly, Salubri come first, even if only people scored with them only 4 times. Brujah and Gangrel follow too, we must wait the 4th clan to see dominate appear as an in-clan discipline.

The most popular clan this period are Brujah  and !Tremere .
